cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll tune your violin for the audition. I work by ear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've tightened that string until it snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. That string couldn't hold pitch. I've saved you a failure onstage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The audition panel heard it snap. They're asking if you know what you're doing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I rejected an unreliable string. Ask for their spare violin; I'll check that one before I approve it.

mechanism: A transforms a broken violin string into a professional quality test, then corrects the audition panel request into an opportunity to supervise more equipment.
confusable: Ordinary perfectionism could reject a faulty string honestly; B must establish A caused the damage while A confidently claims expertise.
comparison: Boiler alternative evades readings; violin alternative reclassifies A destructive action as useful screening.
seedUse: Violin, snapped string and listening panel come from D18-b; S03 uses tuning-procedure distinctions to protect the fake expert role.
